title: Electromagnetic locks: installation, maintenance, testing and verification
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: November 2025 (platform created November 5, 2025, last updated November 5, 2025)

facts.text: The joint interpretation clarifies how the Safety Codes Act, NBC(AE) and NFC(AE) apply to installing, maintaining, testing and verifying electromagnetic locks.
Maglocks must be integrated so that they do not compromise fire protection systems or obstruct exit routes.
Maglocks must be fail-safe, releasing on fire alarm activation, power loss or manual override, and must be compatible with fire-rated doors.
